cutoverPolicy.bookingEnabledRule: BOOKING_ENABLED=true is no-go until every required gate is PASS or explicitly owner-approved as ACCEPTED_RISK or CONFIG_READY_NOT_DRILLED.
cutoverPolicy.trafficSplitCanaryPolicy: Cloud Run traffic-split canary is not used as PASS evidence for Phase 26. Phase 26 uses CI/CD green, 100% direct deploy, and a 15-minute strict watch.
cutoverPolicy.secretPolicy: Evidence must be redacted. Do not store raw Toss keys, payment keys, QR tokens, cookies, OTP values, or PII in this ledger.

gates.failureReason: Direct deploy strict-watch remains unavailable or not run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Run the 15-minute strict watch over health, auth/session, public detail, booking-disabled behavior, queue entry, payment-safe path, and Cloud Run logs.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Rollback on health 5xx, login/refresh failure, public detail 5xx, unsafe booking side effects, queue entry 5xx, or unsafe payment confirm behavior.
gates.redactionNotes: Store revision IDs, timestamps, redacted HTTP statuses, and sanitized log summaries only.

gates.failureReason: Active locale smoke exists, but older five-locale launch wording remains reconciled as non-PASS in Plan 26-07.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep locale scope visible during M1 smoke and do not treat the older five-locale wording as PASS evidence.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not mark M1 smoke PASS if an active locale route or switcher path regresses.
gates.redactionNotes: No cookies or user identifiers in locale smoke evidence.

gates.failureReason: Admin cutover API/UI are implemented, but deployed authenticated admin API smoke and runtime CUTOVER_GATE_LEDGER_PATH evidence are still missing.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Operator can inspect local/read-model semantics, but live enablement waits for deployed admin API smoke against the packaged Gate Ledger artifact.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not proceed to live enablement if the operator cannot inspect current no-go state from the deployed admin surface.
gates.redactionNotes: UI/API must expose sanitized ledger data only.

gates.failureReason: Payment complete page and My Page QR visibility regression evidence recorded.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Verify confirmed paid reservations expose active QR on payment complete and My Page/ticket detail before and after opening.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking if confirmed payment succeeds but QR issuance or visibility fails.
gates.redactionNotes: Do not store raw QR token, JWT, HMAC secret, or ticket bearer payload.

gates.failureReason: Dedicated test-event approval and required PHASE26_TEST_* fixtures were not provided in this executor context; no production-like rehearsal, Toss confirm, or cleanup mutation was run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep live booking closed until dedicated test-event rehearsal covers queue, lock, prepare, payment-safe branch, QR, refund/cancel, and cleanup.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not rely on live cutover readiness if test-key rehearsal fails or remains incomplete.
gates.redactionNotes: Do not store raw Toss keys, payment keys, order IDs, or customer details.

gates.failureReason: D-24 preferred rotation/reissue was not completed, but owner instructed to proceed. This remains non-PASS evidence and must not be treated as final live readiness.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep BOOKING_ENABLED=false until final cutover checks. During rehearsal, use only dedicated test event/order markers, redacted logs, webhook re-query verification, and immediate close-booking/rollback criteria for payment or QR mismatch.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not enable live booking if Toss test rehearsal fails, live-key smoke is unavailable, webhook re-query mismatches provider state, or secret leakage is detected in frontend/logs/artifacts.
gates.redactionNotes: Raw client, secret, and security keys are intentionally omitted. Only key class and short redacted prefixes are recorded.

gates.failureReason: Owner did not confirm Toss review completion or live-key availability in this executor context. No live key prefix/class, server confirm/query/cancel, webhook, or widget smoke was run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep BOOKING_ENABLED=false until live-key smoke passes and Gate Ledger approval is recorded.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not enable booking if live key prefix, server-only handling, widget init, confirm/query/cancel, webhook re-query, or leakage scan fails.
gates.redactionNotes: Record key class/prefix and command shape only; never raw keys.

gates.failureReason: Live-key smoke and/or required Gate Ledger rows are not ready; BOOKING_ENABLED=true was not applied.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep booking closed until readiness passes and the owner approves the runbook go decision.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking immediately on financial or seat safety criteria.
gates.redactionNotes: Final evidence must be sanitized and must not include provider secrets or PII.

gates.failureReason: Dedicated test-event fixture, operator-approved load window, and k6 summary files are not available; real Girl Rules event was not targeted.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record p95 latency under 2 seconds and error rate under 1 percent, or record explicit owner-approved accepted risk.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not open live booking if load gate fails without owner-approved accepted risk.
gates.redactionNotes: Load evidence must use dedicated test identifiers and redacted auth.

gates.failureReason: Dedicated test-event fixture, operator-approved load window, and k6 summary files are not available; real Girl Rules event was not targeted.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record p95 latency under 2 seconds and error rate under 1 percent, or record explicit owner-approved accepted risk.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not open live booking if load gate fails without owner-approved accepted risk.
gates.redactionNotes: Do not load real Girl Rules users, orders, payment paths, or seats.

gates.failureReason: Cloud Run service/revision/traffic metadata collected, but rollback was not drilled.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Keep direct-deploy rollback command shape ready and execute strict watch before cutover.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or rollback if the infra gate affects live booking safety.
gates.redactionNotes: Revision IDs and command shapes are allowed; no auth headers or cookies.

gates.failureReason: Cloud SQL PITR/restore lacks owner-approved safe target, permissions, or PITR metadata.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Use owner-approved safe restore target or preserve accepted risk with clear rollback trigger.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Do not execute destructive cleanup without backup/restore-point confirmation.
gates.redactionNotes: No SQL row dumps, PII, or credentials.

gates.failureReason: Valkey reconnect/failure smoke did not run or lacked required credentials/fixtures.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Run Valkey health/reconnect smoke and watch queue/seat-lock impact.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking if queue, lock, or seat safety signals fail after Valkey disruption.
gates.redactionNotes: Redact redis URLs, auth headers, cookies, JWTs, phone numbers, and customer data.

gates.failureReason: DB_POOL_MAX was collected, but pgBouncer transaction pooling evidence was not found or drilled.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Monitor DB capacity, pool saturation, and booking/payment/seat safety signals.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or rollback if the infra gate affects live booking safety.
gates.redactionNotes: Config summaries only; no connection strings.

gates.failureReason: Cloud SQL HA/read-replica drill evidence is absent; keep non-PASS until approved or drilled.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Monitor DB capacity, pool saturation, and booking/payment/seat safety signals.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or rollback if the infra gate affects live booking safety.
gates.redactionNotes: Resource names and config class are allowed; no credentials or row data.

gates.failureReason: Cloudflare WAF/rate-limit active-rule and smoke evidence remains pending provider evidence.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Record normal-pass smoke and low-volume suspicious challenge/block/rate-limit evidence without impacting real users.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking or tighten controls on traffic-defense bypass, queue abuse, or booking mutation abuse.
gates.redactionNotes: Redact rule IDs if needed; do not store IP addresses tied to real users.

gates.failureReason: One-person on-call playbook exists, but dry-run/provider evidence remains pending.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Dry-run PG/DB, Valkey, Cloud Run, Cloudflare, Toss/payment failure, queue stuck, oversell-risk, QR, and refund procedures.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking when financial or seat safety triage cannot be completed quickly.
gates.redactionNotes: Runbook evidence must use sanitized command shapes and summaries.

gates.failureReason: First-24h watch runbook exists, but live post-open watch handoff has not started.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: After opening, run first-2h checks every 5-10 minutes and 24h checks every 30-60 minutes.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Close booking on duplicate sale, reservation/QR mismatch, payment failure spike, seat mismatch, queue stuck, or refund/cancel buildup.
gates.redactionNotes: Business metric evidence must aggregate or mask customer data.

gates.failureReason: Dedicated test-event approval and required PHASE26_TEST_* fixtures were not provided in this executor context; no production-like rehearsal, Toss confirm, or cleanup mutation was run.
gates.compensatingMonitoring: Cleanup must be constrained by dedicated test IDs, order markers, dry-run counts, and restore-point confirmation.
gates.rollbackOrCloseTrigger: Stop cleanup if dry-run returns unexpected rows or real production records.
gates.redactionNotes: No real Girl Rules row IDs, real user PII, payment keys, or full SQL row dumps.
